object_description: long linear structure with a solid base and gently sloping hipped roof
design_condition: Located north of the existing 50-metre pool, the 92-metre volume establishes a clear boundary between the hard entrance area and the soft landscape, with a punctured entrance through its base.

positive.statement: The project is naturally located in the site and terrain and has a clear and plausible basic disposition.

position.rationale: The elongated building footprint and clear edge condition are visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The central entrance, coherent internal route, and basic basin arrangement are clearly designed.

position.rationale: A central interruption and route through the long volume are legible in the top view.

positive.statement: The division into a massive base and a light wooden roof is obvious and sustainable.

position.target: massive base and light wooden roof
position.rationale: The solid lower band and lighter sloping upper structure are clearly differentiated in elevations.

positive.statement: Beneath the fine wooden trusses, a spatially open but atmospherically intimate bathing landscape is presented.

position.rationale: Trusses and interior atmosphere are only indirectly represented within the upper volume.

positive.statement: The structural sun protection of the canopy avoids the need for additional sun protection.

position.rationale: The canopy is not individually separable, so it is anchored to the upper roof structure.

negative.statement: The entrance depth provides too little daylight.

position.rationale: The entrance is approximated at the front central penetration of the long building.

negative.statement: The ticket zone is not yet convincing, and the theory room lacks daylight and is difficult to reach from the bathing level.

position.rationale: These internal rooms are not distinguishable and are placed near the entrance-side lower volume.

negative.statement: The outdoor-pool cloakrooms are not yet optimally organized.

position.rationale: The outdoor-pool support area is approximated along one end of the ground-level building zone.

negative.statement: The lifeguard lacks a two-sided overview, while the splash pad and multipurpose pool are too small.

position.target: lifeguard, splash pad and multipurpose pool
position.rationale: Internal pool functions are not separable; the marker uses the central bathing area.

negative.statement: The two opposing slide exits are dangerously arranged.

position.rationale: Slide exits are not identifiable, so the marker is placed in the central pool circulation zone.

negative.statement: The central lift location irritates movement in the pool area, and the bathroom floor is under-equipped with a single toilet.

position.rationale: The criticism concerns internal central circulation and amenities within the main lower floor.

negative.statement: The serving area causes high flows of people between the restaurant tables.

position.rationale: Restaurant and serving functions are internal; the marker uses a side zone within the lower volume.
